# Files that are byte-identical to another file here, one sha256 per line with the reason it is kept
# twice. kb_verify.py FAILS on an undeclared duplicate.
#
# This gate exists because on 10 September 2026 I fetched two documents this tree already held, filed
# them under new names, and nothing noticed. A store that accepts the same bytes twice cannot tell you
# what it holds, and the second copy is exactly where a stale revision hides.
#
# The rule for the pairs below: a model or sheet that legitimately serves two folders keeps one copy
# and is declared; anything else is deleted.
